# Offline build dependencies

The source includes resedit 3.1.0 and pe-library 2.0.1, both MIT licensed.
They are used only by `scripts/rebrand-windows.mjs` to set the Windows
application name, version, and icon without requiring Windows or Wine.
Their complete installed package distributions and licenses are preserved here.
They are excluded from application runtime packages.

Upstream: https://github.com/jet2jet/resedit-js and https://github.com/jet2jet/pe-library-js
